scripts.test: cargo test -p dusk && cargo test -p leverage_delegate && yarn test-litesvm
scripts.build:litesvm: anchor build -p dusk && anchor build -p leverage_delegate && cargo build-sbf --manifest-path tests/fixtures/referral_transfer_hook/Cargo.toml --sbf-out-dir target/deploy && cargo build-sbf --manifest-path tests/fixtures/token_metadata_fixture/Cargo.toml --sbf-out-dir target/deploy
scripts.check:clippy: cargo clippy -p dusk --lib -- -A unexpected-cfgs -A clippy::too_many_arguments -D warnings && cargo clippy -p leverage_delegate --lib -- -A unexpected-cfgs -A clippy::too_many_arguments -D warnings
scripts.check:dusk-sdk: npm run check-idl-current --prefix packages/dusk-sdk && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/dusk-sdk
scripts.coverage: cargo tarpaulin -p dusk --out Html --output-dir coverage --exclude-files tests
scripts.v2:build-devnet: mkdir -p target/idl target/types && anchor idl build -p dusk -o target/idl/dusk.json -t target/types/dusk.ts -- --features "development" && rm -f target/deploy/dusk.so && anchor build -p dusk --no-idl -- --features "development" --arch v3
scripts.v2:build-leverage-delegate-devnet: mkdir -p target/idl target/types && anchor idl build -p leverage_delegate -o target/idl/leverage_delegate.json -t target/types/leverage_delegate.ts -- --features "development" && rm -f target/deploy/leverage_delegate.so && anchor build -p leverage_delegate --no-idl -- --features "development" --arch v3
scripts.v2:build-faucet-devnet: mkdir -p target/idl target/types && anchor idl build -p faucet -o target/idl/faucet.json -t target/types/faucet.ts -- --features "development" && rm -f target/deploy/faucet.so && anchor build -p faucet --no-idl -- --features "development" --arch v3
